title: D54（周五）：模拟卡片与前端生成指标
html:
D54（周五）：模拟卡片与前端生成指标

S2 AI前端 · W8 · 2小时。前置：D53-长会话虚拟列表与滚动及前一天面试题。只在验证工程给出参考实现，用户练习代码由你自己手写。

今天要做出什么

扩展同一版本化事件协议，展示明确标注模拟的工具状态、引用片段和结构化结果；为每次生成记录本页首字到达时间、字符速率与中断口径。卡片不执行任何工具、不检索真实资料；指标只存内存、不上报。页面集成留D55。

第四节从验证工程自动读取本章涉及的完整文件。未列出的代码沿用前章；阶段快照保留当天版本。

时间安排（120分钟）

回忆10、知识35、动手55、自检与提交20。到100分钟先砍拓展与选做，保留必做契约和两反证；完整回归等待另计。

零、闭卷回忆

先回答再展开；前三题按昨天、3天前、7天前复习。复测错题本到期项；尚无用户提交，不登记已掌握。

1. D53：上方消息增高后如何保持阅读位置？

答案

用稳定消息ID和行内offset恢复新前缀位置；仅保持scrollTop数值不够。

2. D51：为什么回调和finally都检查归属？

答案

旧结果不能写入新状态，旧finally不能清掉新控制器和计时器。

3. D47：主动停止和失败中断有什么区别？

答案

停止来自用户意图；中断来自失败，两者都保留已收到内容，但统计与提示不能混同。

一、知识点与推导

1.1 卡片必须有自己的契约

tool/citation/result沿用version/runId/messageId/seq。cardId稳定；工具先running后completed/failed，不允许终态回到running，同ID不跨类型复用。schema限制标题、片段、数组大小，Generation最多12张卡。

推导题：为什么卡片不能直接放任意组件名和props？

答案

模型输入不能决定任意组件和事件处理器。受控type映射固定组件与文本字段，避免越过渲染和执行边界。

1.2 展示不代表真实执行

mockCards只在mock模式、done之前插入固定演示事件，所有卡片显示模拟标签；真实mode:model拒绝此类模拟卡片。没有设备请求、知识库查询或工具副作用。W7后端协议不变。

推导题：工具卡片completed证明了什么？

答案

只证明本地模拟状态转换完成，不证明设备健康、真实工具成功或资料可信。引用标题也不是自动生成的事实背书。

1.3 首字与速率计量

使用单调时钟记录开始、首个非空text、终止；空文本不触发首字。字符按Unicode码点计数，速率=总字符数/(终止-首字)，没有文本或时间跨度为0返回null。此TTFT测接收回调，不是首像素呈现，也不是模型纯推理延迟。

推导题：为什么不能把字符/秒写成TPS？

答案

tokens取决于分词器和供应商usage，中文、emoji与UTF16长度均不同。没有真实token数量就只能报告字符速率。

1.4 中断率的分母必须可解释

仅本页已结束且非主动停止的请求进入分母；error/interrupted为分子，completed/truncated不是中断；进行中不计，分母0返回null。终态只结算一次。每个attempt持有自己的timer，finally总清自己的timer，仅当前attempt可清共享控制器。

推导题：截断算成功还是错误？

答案

本UI单列truncated，不能说完整成功；在本章中断率中它不是网络/协议中断，但可另定义截断率。业务口径必须写明。

二、自己动手（必做）

步骤1：扩事件与卡片状态（20分钟）

提示1：方向

复用身份和去重层，先验证状态转换再更新卡片。

提示2：API与文档位置

shared/conversation.ts与generation.ts；固定type/cardId/state。

提示3：伪代码

strict schema→mock模式→查同ID→验证状态转换/数量→提交→更新seq指纹。

步骤2：插模拟事件与安全展示（15分钟）

提示1：方向

所有卡片只用文本插值，不触发执行操作。

提示2：API与文档位置

mockCards在mock的done之前调用；AssistantCards固定模板。

提示3：伪代码

running→completed→citation→result；每条seq=lastSeq+1；最后再应用done。

步骤3：添加本地指标（20分钟）

提示1：方向

用可注入时钟测试，无真实等待，终态不可重复结算。

提示2：API与文档位置

startMetrics/measureText/finishMetrics/metricsView/summarizeMetrics。

提示3：伪代码

第一次非空文本记first；累计码点；终态记end；过滤eligible后计算rate，无分母返回null。

四、本章完整源码

4.1 本章源码与测试

packages/shared/src/conversation.ts

import { z } from 'zod';

const identity = {
  version: z.literal(1),
  runId: z.string().min(1).max(64),
  messageId: z.string().min(1).max(64),
  seq: z.number().int().min(1).max(4096),
};
// 界面协议独立版本；W7的HTTP协议由前端适配，后续卡片沿用同一身份和序号。
export const conversationEventSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  z.object({ ...identity, type:z.literal('tool'), cardId:z.string().min(1).max(64), state:z.enum(['running','completed','failed']), label:z.string().min(1).max(120) }).strict(),
  z.object({ ...identity, type:z.literal('citation'), cardId:z.string().min(1).max(64), title:z.string().min(1).max(120), excerpt:z.string().max(1000) }).strict(),
  z.object({ ...identity, type:z.literal('result'), cardId:z.string().min(1).max(64), title:z.string().min(1).max(120), items:z.array(z.string().max(200)).max(8) }).strict(),

  z.object({ ...identity, type: z.literal('start'), mode: z.enum(['mock', 'model']) }).strict(),
  z.object({ ...identity, type: z.literal('text'), text: z.string().max(16_384) }).strict(),
  z.object({ ...identity, type: z.literal('finish'), reason: z.enum(['stop', 'length']) }).strict(),
  z.object({ ...identity, type: z.literal('failure'), code: z.enum(['MODEL_UNAVAILABLE', 'MODEL_PROTOCOL_ERROR', 'MODEL_OUTPUT_LIMIT', 'MODEL_TIMEOUT', 'MODEL_CANCELLED']) }).strict(),
]);
export type ConversationEvent = z.infer<typeof conversationEventSchema>;

apps/web/src/assistant/generation.ts

import { conversationEventSchema, type ConversationEvent } from '@ops-ticket/shared'

export type GenerationStatus = 'connecting' | 'streaming' | 'completed' | 'truncated' | 'stopped' | 'interrupted' | 'error'
export type AssistantCard = Extract<ConversationEvent, {type:'tool'|'citation'|'result'}>
export interface Generation {
  cards: AssistantCard[]
  runId: string
  messageId: string
  status: GenerationStatus
  mode: 'mock' | 'model' | null
  text: string
  error: string | null
  lastSeq: number
  seen: Record<number, string>
}
export class ConversationError extends Error {}
export const isGenerating = (run: Generation) => run.status === 'connecting' || run.status === 'streaming'
export function createGeneration(runId: string, messageId: string): Generation {
  return { cards: [], runId, messageId, status: 'connecting', mode: null, text: '', error: null, lastSeq: 0, seen: {} }
}
export function stopGeneration(run: Generation) { if (isGenerating(run)) run.status = 'stopped' }
export function failGeneration(run: Generation, code: string) {
  if (!isGenerating(run)) return
  run.status = run.text ? 'interrupted' : 'error'; run.error = code
}

// 校验全部通过后才提交状态；重复事件去重不等于请求幂等或断线恢复。
export function applyConversationEvent(run: Generation, input: unknown): 'applied' | 'duplicate' | 'stale' | 'terminal' {
  const parsed = conversationEventSchema.safeParse(input)
  if (!parsed.success) throw new ConversationError('EVENT_CONTRACT')
  const event = parsed.data
  if (event.runId !== run.runId || event.messageId !== run.messageId) return 'stale'
  const fingerprint = JSON.stringify(event)
  if (run.seen[event.seq] !== undefined) {
    if (run.seen[event.seq] !== fingerprint) throw new ConversationError('EVENT_CONFLICT')
    return 'duplicate'
  }
  if (!isGenerating(run)) return 'terminal'
  if (event.seq !== run.lastSeq + 1) throw new ConversationError('EVENT_SEQUENCE')
  if (event.type === 'start' ? run.lastSeq !== 0 : run.mode === null) throw new ConversationError('EVENT_ORDER')
  if (event.type === 'text' && run.text.length + event.text.length > 32_768) throw new ConversationError('OUTPUT_LIMIT')
  if (event.type === 'tool' || event.type === 'citation' || event.type === 'result') {
    if (run.mode !== 'mock') throw new ConversationError('MOCK_CARD_ONLY')
    const index = run.cards.findIndex(card => card.cardId === event.cardId)
    const previous = run.cards[index]
    if (previous) {
      if (previous.type !== 'tool' || event.type !== 'tool' || previous.state !== 'running' || event.state === 'running' || previous.label !== event.label) throw new ConversationError('CARD_ORDER')
    } else {
      if (run.cards.length >= 12) throw new ConversationError('CARD_LIMIT')
      if (event.type === 'tool' && event.state !== 'running') throw new ConversationError('CARD_ORDER')
    }
    if (index < 0) run.cards.push(event); else run.cards[index] = event
  }
  if (event.type === 'start') run.mode = event.mode
  if (event.type === 'text') { run.text += event.text; run.status = 'streaming' }
  if (event.type === 'finish') run.status = event.reason === 'length' ? 'truncated' : 'completed'
  if (event.type === 'failure') { run.error = event.code; run.status = run.text ? 'interrupted' : 'error' }
  run.lastSeq = event.seq; run.seen[event.seq] = fingerprint
  return 'applied'
}

apps/web/src/assistant/cards.ts

import type { ConversationEvent } from '@ops-ticket/shared'
import { applyConversationEvent, type Generation } from './generation'
// 显式模拟数据，只演示UI协议；不访问设备、知识库或执行任何工具。
export function mockCards(run:Generation) {
  if(run.mode!=='mock')return
  const identity={version:1 as const,runId:run.runId,messageId:run.messageId}
  const entries=[
    {type:'tool',cardId:'demo-check',state:'running',label:'模拟检查设备状态'},
    {type:'tool',cardId:'demo-check',state:'completed',label:'模拟检查设备状态'},
    {type:'citation',cardId:'demo-source',title:'模拟排查手册',excerpt:'这是本地构造的演示资料，不代表实际知识库检索。'},
    {type:'result',cardId:'demo-result',title:'模拟检查结果',items:['未连接真实设备','建议由人工复核']},
  ]
  for(const entry of entries)applyConversationEvent(run,{...identity,...entry,seq:run.lastSeq+1} as ConversationEvent)
}

apps/web/src/assistant/metrics.ts

import type { GenerationStatus } from './generation'
export interface GenerationMetrics { startedAt:number; firstTextAt:number|null; endedAt:number|null; chars:number; outcome:GenerationStatus|null }
export const startMetrics=(now:number):GenerationMetrics=>({startedAt:now,firstTextAt:null,endedAt:null,chars:0,outcome:null})
export function measureText(metric:GenerationMetrics,text:string,now:number) {
  if(metric.endedAt!==null || !text.length)return
  if(metric.firstTextAt===null)metric.firstTextAt=now
  metric.chars+=Array.from(text).length
}
export function finishMetrics(metric:GenerationMetrics,outcome:GenerationStatus,now:number) {
  if(metric.endedAt!==null || outcome==='connecting' || outcome==='streaming')return
  metric.endedAt=now;metric.outcome=outcome
}
export function metricsView(metric:GenerationMetrics) {
  const elapsed=metric.firstTextAt===null || metric.endedAt===null ? null : metric.endedAt-metric.firstTextAt
  return {ttftMs:metric.firstTextAt===null?null:Math.max(0,metric.firstTextAt-metric.startedAt),durationMs:metric.endedAt===null?null:Math.max(0,metric.endedAt-metric.startedAt),chars:metric.chars,charsPerSecond:elapsed!==null && elapsed>0 ? metric.chars*1000/elapsed:null,outcome:metric.outcome}
}
// 本页已结束且非主动停止的请求为分母；截断单列，不计为网络中断。
export function summarizeMetrics(metrics:GenerationMetrics[]) {
  const eligible=metrics.filter(metric=>metric.endedAt!==null && metric.outcome!=='stopped')
  const interrupted=eligible.filter(metric=>metric.outcome==='interrupted' || metric.outcome==='error').length
  return {eligible:eligible.length,interrupted,interruptionRate:eligible.length?interrupted/eligible.length:null}
}

apps/web/src/assistant/cards.spec.ts

import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest'
import {appendFileSync} from 'node:fs'
import {applyConversationEvent as apply,createGeneration} from './generation'
import {mockCards} from './cards'
import {finishMetrics,measureText,metricsView,startMetrics,summarizeMetrics} from './metrics'
const event=(seq:number,extra:object)=>({version:1,runId:'r',messageId:'m',seq,...extra})
const begun=(mode='mock')=>{const run=createGeneration('r','m');apply(run,event(1,{type:'start',mode}));return run}
const report=(value:object)=>{if(process.env.D54_EVIDENCE_FILE)appendFileSync(process.env.D54_EVIDENCE_FILE,JSON.stringify(value)+'\n')}
describe('模拟卡片和生成指标（D54）',()=>{
  it('模拟工具状态引用结果保持身份与顺序',()=>{const run=begun();mockCards(run);expect(run.cards.map(card=>card.type)).toEqual(['tool','citation','result']);expect(run.cards[0]).toMatchObject({state:'completed'});expect(run.lastSeq).toBe(5);report({case:'mock-cards',types:run.cards.map(c=>c.type),toolState:run.cards[0]!.type==='tool'?run.cards[0]!.state:null,lastSeq:run.lastSeq})})
  it('真实模式不能伪造模拟卡片',()=>{const run=begun('model');expect(()=>apply(run,event(2,{type:'tool',cardId:'t',state:'running',label:'模拟'}))).toThrow('MOCK_CARD_ONLY');mockCards(run);expect(run.cards).toHaveLength(0)})
  it('工具必须先running再终态',()=>{const run=begun();expect(()=>apply(run,event(2,{type:'tool',cardId:'t',state:'completed',label:'模拟'}))).toThrow('CARD_ORDER');expect(run.lastSeq).toBe(1)})
  it('工具终态不能重新运行',()=>{const run=begun();mockCards(run);expect(()=>apply(run,event(6,{type:'tool',cardId:'demo-check',state:'running',label:'模拟检查设备状态'}))).toThrow('CARD_ORDER')})
  it('卡片ID不能跨类型复用',()=>{const run=begun();mockCards(run);expect(()=>apply(run,event(6,{type:'result',cardId:'demo-source',title:'错',items:[]}))).toThrow('CARD_ORDER')})
  it('重复卡片事件只登记一次',()=>{const run=begun();const card=event(2,{type:'citation',cardId:'c',title:'模拟',excerpt:'片段'});apply(run,card);expect(apply(run,card)).toBe('duplicate');expect(run.cards).toHaveLength(1)})
  it('卡片数量上限十二',()=>{const run=begun();for(let i=0;i<12;i++)apply(run,event(i+2,{type:'citation',cardId:String(i),title:'模拟',excerpt:''}));expect(()=>apply(run,event(14,{type:'citation',cardId:'extra',title:'模拟',excerpt:''}))).toThrow('CARD_LIMIT')})
  it('停止后卡片不新增',()=>{const run=begun();run.status='stopped';mockCards(run);expect(run.cards).toHaveLength(0)})
  it('首字忽略空文本并按Unicode码点计字符',()=>{const m=startMetrics(100);measureText(m,'',110);measureText(m,'中😀',250);measureText(m,'文',750);finishMetrics(m,'completed',1250);expect(metricsView(m)).toEqual({ttftMs:150,durationMs:1150,chars:3,charsPerSecond:3,outcome:'completed'});report({case:'generation-metrics',...metricsView(m)})})
  it('无正文和零耗时不能伪造速率',()=>{const m=startMetrics(10);finishMetrics(m,'error',20);expect(metricsView(m).ttftMs).toBeNull();expect(metricsView(m).charsPerSecond).toBeNull();const n=startMetrics(0);measureText(n,'x',1);finishMetrics(n,'completed',1);expect(metricsView(n).charsPerSecond).toBeNull()})
  it('终态计量只结算一次',()=>{const m=startMetrics(0);measureText(m,'x',1);finishMetrics(m,'stopped',2);finishMetrics(m,'completed',3);measureText(m,'迟到',4);expect(metricsView(m)).toMatchObject({chars:1,durationMs:2,outcome:'stopped'})})
  it('中断率排除主动停止和进行中',()=>{const rows=['completed','interrupted','error','stopped','truncated'] as const;const ms=rows.map(outcome=>{const m=startMetrics(0);finishMetrics(m,outcome,10);return m});ms.push(startMetrics(0));expect(summarizeMetrics(ms)).toEqual({eligible:4,interrupted:2,interruptionRate:.5});report({case:'interruption-rate',...summarizeMetrics(ms)})})
  it('无可计分母返回null',()=>{expect(summarizeMetrics([]).interruptionRate).toBeNull()})
})

import { mockCards } from '../assistant/cards'
import { startMetrics, measureText, finishMetrics, type GenerationMetrics } from '../assistant/metrics'
import { computed, getCurrentScope, onScopeDispose, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import type { AssistantEvent, ConversationEvent } from '@ops-ticket/shared'
import { streamAssistant } from '../api/assistant'
import { session } from '../api/session'
import { applyConversationEvent, createGeneration, failGeneration, isGenerating, stopGeneration, type Generation } from '../assistant/generation'

export interface ConversationTurn { id: string; parentId: string | null; question: string; run: Generation; metrics: GenerationMetrics }
export function adaptEvent(event: AssistantEvent, run: Generation, seq: number): ConversationEvent {
  const identity = { version: 1 as const, runId: run.runId, messageId: run.messageId, seq }
  if (event.type === 'meta') return { ...identity, type: 'start', mode: event.mode }
  if (event.type === 'delta') return { ...identity, type: 'text', text: event.text }
  if (event.type === 'done') return { ...identity, type: 'finish', reason: event.finishReason }
  return { ...identity, type: 'failure', code: event.code }
}

// 仅保存当前页面的内存分支；HTTP仍只发送当前问题，不冒充多轮模型上下文。
export function useConversation(ticketNo: () => string, transport = streamAssistant, now = () => performance.now()) {
  const turns = ref<ConversationTurn[]>([]); const activeLeaf = ref<string | null>(null); const error = ref('')
  let epoch = 0; let disposed = false; let controller: AbortController | undefined
  let currentRun: Generation | undefined; let deadline: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  const busy = computed(() => turns.value.some(turn => isGenerating(turn.run)))
  const path = computed(() => {
    const rows: ConversationTurn[] = []; let id = activeLeaf.value
    while (id) { const turn = turns.value.find(row => row.id === id); if (!turn) break; rows.unshift(turn); id = turn.parentId }
    return rows
  })
  const cancel = () => { epoch++; controller?.abort(); controller = undefined; clearTimeout(deadline); deadline = undefined }
  function stop() { if (currentRun) { stopGeneration(currentRun); const turn=turns.value.find(row=>row.run.runId===currentRun?.runId); if(turn)finishMetrics(turn.metrics,turn.run.status,now()) } cancel(); currentRun = undefined }
  function reset() { stop(); turns.value = []; activeLeaf.value = null; error.value = '' }
  const unwatch = watch([ticketNo, () => session.value?.accessToken], reset, { flush: 'sync' })

  async function generate(question: string, parentId: string | null): Promise<boolean> {
    if (disposed || busy.value) return false
    const token = session.value?.accessToken; const ticket = ticketNo(); const prompt = question.trim()
    if (!token || !ticket || !prompt || prompt.length > 1000) { error.value = '请登录并输入1—1000字的问题'; return false }
    if (parentId && !turns.value.some(turn => turn.id === parentId)) return false
    // 为本次最大回答预留预算；到限拒绝新请求，绝不偷偷截掉旧分支。
    if (turns.value.length >= 200 || turns.value.reduce((sum, turn) => sum + turn.question.length + turn.run.text.length, 0) + prompt.length + 32_768 > 1_000_000) {
      error.value = '当前会话已到容量上限，请保留所需内容后重新进入页面'; return false
    }
    error.value = ''; const id = crypto.randomUUID()
    turns.value.push({ id, parentId, question: prompt, run: createGeneration(crypto.randomUUID(), id), metrics:startMetrics(now()) })
    const turn = turns.value[turns.value.length - 1]!; const run = turn.run
    activeLeaf.value = id; currentRun = run
    const attempt = ++epoch; const abort = new AbortController(); controller = abort; let localDeadline: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
    const current = () => !disposed && attempt === epoch && token === session.value?.accessToken && ticket === ticketNo()
    let onAbort: () => void = () => {}
    const cancelled = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
      onAbort = () => reject(new Error('CANCELLED')); abort.signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true })
    })
    localDeadline = setTimeout(() => {
      if (current()) { failGeneration(run, 'MODEL_TIMEOUT'); abort.abort() }
    }, 45_000)
    deadline=localDeadline
    try {
      await Promise.race([transport(ticket, prompt, token, abort.signal, event => {
        if (!current()) return
        if (event.type === 'done') mockCards(run)
        const result=applyConversationEvent(run, adaptEvent(event, run, run.lastSeq+1))
        if(result==='applied' && event.type==='delta')measureText(turn.metrics,event.text,now())
        if(!isGenerating(run))finishMetrics(turn.metrics,run.status,now())
      }), cancelled])
      if (current() && isGenerating(run)) failGeneration(run, 'STREAM_INTERRUPTED')
    } catch {
      if (current()) failGeneration(run, 'GENERATION_FAILED')
    } finally {
      abort.signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort)
      clearTimeout(localDeadline)
      finishMetrics(turn.metrics,run.status,now())
      if (current()) { clearTimeout(deadline); deadline = undefined; controller = undefined; currentRun = undefined }
    }
    return true
  }
  function fork(id: string, question?: string) {
    const old = turns.value.find(turn => turn.id === id)
    return old ? generate(question ?? old.question, old.parentId) : Promise.resolve(false)
  }
  function select(id: string) {
    if (busy.value || !turns.value.some(turn => turn.id === id)) return false
    activeLeaf.value = id; return true
  }
  function dispose() { if (disposed) return; reset(); disposed = true; unwatch() }
  if (getCurrentScope()) onScopeDispose(dispose)
  return { turns, path, activeLeaf, busy, error, send: (question: string) => generate(question, activeLeaf.value), fork, select, stop, reset, dispose }
}

apps/server/test/rbac.e2e-spec.ts

import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PERMISSIONS } from '@ops-ticket/shared';
import request from 'supertest';
import { App } from 'supertest/types.js';
import { AppModule } from './../src/app.module.js';
import { configureApp } from './../src/app.setup.js';
import { PermissionsService } from './../src/auth/permissions.service.js';
import { PrismaService } from './../src/prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { tokenIssuer } from './auth.js';
import { TicketFixtures } from './fixtures.js';

// D16：角色与权限点
describe('角色与权限 (e2e)', () => {
  let app: INestApplication<App>;
  let prisma: PrismaService;
  let auth: (username: string) => string;
  let fixtures: TicketFixtures;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const moduleFixture = await Test.createTestingModule({
      imports: [AppModule],
    }).compile();
    app = moduleFixture.createNestApplication();
    configureApp(app);
    await app.init();
    auth = await tokenIssuer(app);
    prisma = app.get(PrismaService);
    fixtures = new TicketFixtures(prisma, 'RB');
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await fixtures.cleanup();
    await app.close();
  });

  const http = () => request(app.getHttpServer());

  it('批量指派只有组长能做：处理人返回 403 并说明缺少的权限，工单不变', async () => {
    const { ticketNo } = await fixtures.create();
    const body = { ticketNos: [ticketNo], assignee: 'bob' };

    const denied = await http().post('/api/tickets/batch-assign').set('authorization', auth('bob')).send(body).expect(403);
    expect(denied.body.error).toEqual({ code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: '没有权限：ticket:assign' });
    const ticket = await prisma.ticket.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { ticketNo }, select: { version: true } });
    expect(ticket.version).toBe(0);

    await http().post('/api/tickets/batch-assign').set('authorization', auth('carol')).send(body).expect(200);
  });

  it('只读用户能看列表和详情，不能接单；系统账号不能看工单，处理人不能上报告警', async () => {
    const { ticketNo } = await fixtures.create();
    await http().get('/api/tickets?limit=1').set('authorization', auth('dave')).expect(200);
    await http().get(`/api/tickets/${ticketNo}`).set('authorization', auth('dave')).expect(200);
    await http()
      .post(`/api/tickets/${ticketNo}/transitions`)
      .set('authorization', auth('dave'))
      .send({ action: 'accept', version: 0 })
      .expect(403);

    await http().get('/api/tickets?limit=1').set('authorization', auth('monitor')).expect(403);
    await http()
      .post('/api/alerts')
      .set('authorization', auth('bob'))
      .send({ source: 'manual', dedupKey: 'rb-1', deviceCode: 'srv-001', severity: 'minor', message: 'x', occurredAt: '2026-11-15T00:00:00.000Z' })
      .expect(403);
  });

  it('删除设备需要 device:manage：运维人员返回 403', async () => {
    const res = await http().delete('/api/devices/srv-001').set('authorization', auth('alice')).expect(403);
    expect(res.body.error.message).toBe('没有权限：device:manage');
  });

  it('直接改数据库、不通知缓存：权限缓存有效期内仍是旧权限（D23）', async () => {
    const dave = await prisma.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { username: 'dave' } });
    const operator = await prisma.role.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'operator' } });
    const { ticketNo } = await fixtures.create();
    // 独立建立本用例的30秒窗口，避免复用前序用例接近过期的缓存。
    await app.get(PermissionsService).invalidate(dave.id);
    // 先请求一次，让 dave 的权限进缓存
    await http().get('/api/tickets?limit=1').set('authorization', auth('dave')).expect(200);
    try {
      await prisma.userRole.create({ data: { userId: dave.id, roleId: operator.id } });
      await http()
        .post(`/api/tickets/${ticketNo}/transitions`)
        .set('authorization', auth('dave'))
        .send({ action: 'accept', version: 0 })
        .expect(403);
    } finally {
      await prisma.userRole.delete({ where: { userId_roleId: { userId: dave.id, roleId: operator.id } } });
      await app.get(PermissionsService).invalidate(dave.id);
    }
  });

  it('改角色后调用 invalidate：同一个令牌立即能接单；去掉角色再 invalidate 后立即不能', async () => {
    const dave = await prisma.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { username: 'dave' } });
    const operator = await prisma.role.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'operator' } });
    const token = auth('dave'); // 整个用例用同一个令牌
    const permissions = app.get(PermissionsService);
    const accept = (ticketNo: string) =>
      http().post(`/api/tickets/${ticketNo}/transitions`).set('authorization', token).send({ action: 'accept', version: 0 });

    try {
      await prisma.userRole.create({ data: { userId: dave.id, roleId: operator.id } });
      // 权限有 30 秒缓存（D23）：改角色的地方要负责让缓存失效
      await permissions.invalidate(dave.id);
      const first = await fixtures.create();
      await accept(first.ticketNo).expect(200);
    } finally {
      await prisma.userRole.delete({ where: { userId_roleId: { userId: dave.id, roleId: operator.id } } });
      await permissions.invalidate(dave.id);
    }
    const second = await fixtures.create();
    await accept(second.ticketNo).expect(403);
  });

  it('代码里的每个权限点都在数据库里，并且至少有一个角色拥有它', async () => {
    const rows = await prisma.permission.findMany({ select: { code: true, _count: { select: { roles: true } } } });
    const inDb = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.code, r._count.roles]));
    for (const code of PERMISSIONS) {
      expect(inDb.get(code), code).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });
});

五、核心面试题

  1. 如何设计工具、引用和结果卡片协议？ 要点：固定type与字段上限，统一version/run/message/seq；cardId定位状态更新，工具running只能进入一次终态。渲染器固定组件与文本字段，不接受模型提供组件路径或任意props。追问：引用卡片等于事实可信？不，资料来源和内容核实另有流程。
  2. 如何定义本章TTFT和字符速率？ 要点：从生成动作建立本地记录，到首次非空文本回调为TTFT；字符按Unicode码点数，速率分母从首字到终止。无文本/零跨度为null。追问：为什么不同于用户感知TTFT？rAF、Markdown解析和绘制在回调之后，首像素需要另测。
  3. 中断率怎样避免把用户停止算故障？ 要点：分母只取已结束且非stopped，分子为error/interrupted；进行中不进入，truncated另列，无样本为null。保留原outcome，便于以后换口径重算。追问：是否可以直接当线上SLA？本页样本短暂、无持久采样与上报，不能代表全量服务质量。

完整原题、答案、补充和网络来源见D54面试题。

六、个人建议

面试讲指标先给口径与样本边界，再给数字。用“中😀文是3个码点、4个UTF16单元”解释为什么不叫tokens；讲卡片时明确UI状态与真实执行证据的区别。
